Would you be able to keep him inside after eleven?
Can we agree to try that for a week?

beats.text: Was it barking again last night?
He's just anxious when I'm out.
I can try closing the window.
Okay, inside after eleven.
Let's see how it goes.

title: 服务态度投诉
goal: 要求道歉和改进，不退化成吵架
brief: 你被客服挂断电话。你要投诉，但要拿到处理结果。
opener: I'm sorry you feel that way.

cast.name: Dana
cast.stance: 标准话术，容易说“会反馈”。
cast.opener: I'm sorry you feel that way.

must: I don't want an apology, I want
phrases: I don't want an apology — I want a callback from a manager.
Can you confirm the ticket number?
What's the next step and when?

beats.text: I'm sorry you feel that way.
I'll pass it to the team.
Someone will call you.
Within 24 hours.
Here's your ticket number.

hints: 要具体处理，不接受泛泛道歉

title: 要求退款
goal: 在规则内拿到退款或明确拒绝理由
brief: 服务没达到承诺，你要求退款。对方会拿条款挡。
opener: Our policy says no refunds after 14 days.

cast.name: Victor
cast.stance: 按条款，习惯直接拒绝。
cast.opener: Our policy says no refunds after 14 days.

phrases: The service wasn't delivered as promised.
Can you check what the terms actually say?
What can you offer instead of a full refund?

beats.text: Our policy says no refunds after 14 days.
You agreed to the terms.
I can offer a credit.
Half refund is possible.
I'll process that today.

title: 要求见负责人
goal: 升级到有权限的人，并说清诉求
brief: 一线解决不了，你要升级。要说清问题和诉求，不情绪化。
opener: I'm the only one here right now.

cast.name: Sam
cast.stance: 没权限，会说“我帮你记录”。
cast.opener: I'm the only one here right now.

phrases: I need someone who can authorize a refund.
The issue is the wrong item plus a missed delivery.
Can you confirm a callback time?

beats.text: I'm the only one here right now.
I can take a message.
The manager is back tomorrow.
I'll book a callback at ten.
Here's the reference.

title: 护照丢失求助
goal: 报警/联系使馆，问清补办流程
brief: 护照丢了，你要说清时间地点，问下一步。
opener: When did you last see your passport?

cast.name: Miller
cast.stance: 按流程，问时间地点。
cast.opener: When did you last see your passport?

phrases: I last saw it at the hotel around noon.
I need a police report for the embassy.
What's the next step to replace it?

beats.text: When did you last see your passport?
Where were you at the time?
We'll file a report.
Take this to your embassy.
Here's the case number.

hints: 要报案号，方便使馆补办

title: 报警描述事件
goal: 说清地点、发生了什么、是否有人受伤
brief: 你目击一起事故。要短、清楚、按优先级说。
opener: What's your emergency?

cast.name: Anna
cast.stance: 训练有素，会按顺序问。
cast.opener: What's your emergency?

phrases: There's been an accident at the corner of Fifth and Main.
I'm at the coffee shop on the corner.
One person is hurt but conscious.

beats.text: What's your emergency?
Where exactly are you?
Is anyone injured?
Stay on the line.
Help is on the way.

hints: 地点 + 事件 + 伤情

title: 急诊说明情况
goal: 说清症状、过敏和用药
brief: 你陪朋友来急诊。要快速说清症状和过敏史。
opener: What's the problem today?

cast.name: Nina
cast.stance: 忙，问关键信息。
cast.opener: What's the problem today?

phrases: He has chest pain and shortness of breath.
It started about an hour ago.
He's allergic to aspirin.

beats.text: What's the problem today?
How long ago did it start?
Any allergies?
Any medication?
We'll take him now.

hints: 症状 + 开始时间 + 过敏

title: 活动自我介绍
goal: 30 秒说清你是谁、做什么、想认识谁
brief: 你要在 30 秒内介绍自己，并让对方愿意继续聊。
opener: Hi — what do you do?

cast.name: Rachel
cast.stance: 开放，但时间有限。
cast.opener: Hi — what do you do?

phrases: I'm a backend engineer at a payments company.
I work on fraud detection.
I'm here to meet people in fintech.

beats.text: Hi — what do you do?
Oh, interesting. What kind of fraud?
We're looking at that too.
Let's compare notes.
I'll send you a message.

hints: 30 秒：身份 + 方向 + 目的

title: 加入一圈人的对话
goal: 自然切入，不被当成打断
brief: 你想加入一个小圈子。要先听、再认同、再提问。
opener: Sorry, are you with us?

cast.name: Ben
cast.stance: 圈子已形成，会礼貌但警惕。
cast.opener: Sorry, are you with us?

cast.name: Mia
cast.stance: 愿意接纳新人，会帮你接话。

must: Do you mind if I ask
phrases: I overheard you talking about latency — that's my area too.
That matches what we saw last quarter.
Do you mind if I ask how you measured it?

beats.text: Sorry, are you with us?
We were just talking about latency.
Oh, you work on that too?
How did you measure it?
Join us — we're comparing notes.

hints: 先认同对方观点，再切入
用问题加入，不用陈述打断

title: 活动后跟进
goal: 发出有信息量的跟进，拿到下一次见面
brief: 你在活动上认识了一个人。跟进消息要具体，不要只发“nice to meet you”。
opener: Hey, good meeting you yesterday.

cast.name: Rachel
cast.stance: 愿意聊，但消息多，容易忘。
cast.opener: Hey, good meeting you yesterday.

phrases: You mentioned you're evaluating vendors.
I looked into the tool you mentioned.
Would you be open to a 20-minute call?

beats.text: Hey, good meeting you yesterday.
Remind me what you work on?
We're still evaluating.
A short call could help.
Thursday works.

hints: 提到对方说过的具体点
给一个 20 分钟的小请求

title: 开学第一天：和新同学打招呼
goal: 用 Good morning / What's your name 认识一位新同学
place: 开学第一天早上，七年级教室门口
brief: 你刚转到这所学校，走进教室时一个男生主动跟你打招呼。用课本 Starter Unit 1 的问候语，问清名字，再简单回答他。
opener: Good morning! I'm Tom. What's your name?

cast.name: Tom
cast.stance: 他很外向，会先打招呼，再问你名字和今天好不好。语速慢、句子短。
cast.opener: Good morning! I'm Tom. What's your name?

phrases: Good morning! My name is Li Hua.
What's your name?
How are you? I'm fine, thanks.

beats.text: Good morning! I'm Tom. What's your name?
Nice to meet you. How are you today?
I'm fine, too. Welcome to our class!

hints: 先回 Good morning，再说 I'm…
问名字用 What's your name
见面说 Nice to meet you

title: 问物品：这是什么？怎么拼？
goal: 用 What's this in English 问物品，并会拼写
place: 教室里，同桌的桌上放着学习用品
brief: 同桌指着桌上的东西问你英文怎么说。用 Starter Unit 2 的句型问清楚，并说出它是什么。
opener: What's this in English?

cast.name: Lucy
cast.stance: 她很有耐心，会一个词一个词地问，也会让你拼写。
cast.opener: What's this in English?

phrases: What's this in English? It's a ruler.
How do you spell it?
Please keep your desk tidy.

beats.text: What's this in English?
Yes, it's a dictionary. How do you spell it?
Good. Please keep your desk tidy.

hints: 问物品用 What's this in English
拼写问 How do you spell it

title: 说颜色：它是什么颜色
goal: 用 What colour is it 问答颜色，说出自己喜欢的颜色
place: 美术课前，老师拿着一盒彩笔
brief: 老师拿起不同颜色的笔问你。用 Starter Unit 3 的颜色词和句型回答，再问问同学喜欢什么颜色。
opener: Look at this pen. What colour is it?

cast.name: Ms Li
cast.stance: 她语速慢，会重复关键词，鼓励学生开口。
cast.opener: Look at this pen. What colour is it?

cast.name: Anna
cast.stance: 她坐在你旁边，会主动问你最喜欢的颜色。

phrases: What colour is it? It's blue.
What's your favourite colour?
My favourite colour is green.

beats.text: What colour is it?
Yes, it's red. And this one?
I like green. What's your favourite colour?

hints: 问颜色用 What colour is it
说喜欢用 My favourite colour is

title: 自我介绍：你来自哪里
goal: 问名字、年龄、来自哪里，完整介绍自己
place: 新学期第一节英语课，小组互相认识
brief: 老师让你们四人一组互相介绍。用 Unit 1 的句型说清名字、年龄、来自哪里，再反问对方。
opener: Hi, I'm Anna. Are you new here?

cast.name: Anna
cast.stance: 她先介绍自己，再问你三个问题：名字、年龄、来自哪里。
cast.opener: Hi, I'm Anna. Are you new here?

cast.name: Mike
cast.stance: 他会补充问你的班级和电话号码。

phrases: My name is Li Hua. I'm from Beijing.
I'm thirteen years old.
Where are you from?

beats.text: Hi, I'm Anna. Are you new here?
Where are you from?
How old are you?
Nice to meet you. Welcome to our group!

hints: 被问来自哪用 I'm from…

title: 介绍家人：这是我的…
goal: 用 This is my… 介绍家人，问清谁是谁
place: 课间，Lucy 看到你桌上的全家福
brief: Lucy 拿起你的全家福问照片里的人。用 Unit 2 的句型和名词所有格，介绍家人并回答她。
opener: Is this your family photo?

cast.name: Lucy
cast.stance: 她对照片很感兴趣，会问 Who's he / Who's she，也会问是不是你的。
cast.opener: Is this your family photo?

phrases: This is my father. He's a teacher.
Who's she? She's my sister.
Are these your grandparents? Yes, they are.

beats.text: Is this your family photo?
Who's he?
And who's she? Is she your sister?
Are these your grandparents?

hints: 介绍人用 This is my…

title: 介绍学校：教室在哪里
goal: 用 There is/are 和方位介词介绍学校
place: 新生参观校园，Mike 带你走一圈
brief: Mike 带你参观学校，你要说清学校里有什么、教室在哪里，也要问他怎么走。
opener: Welcome to our school! Let me show you around.

cast.name: Mike
cast.stance: 他熟悉校园，会问 There is / Are there，也会指路。
cast.opener: Welcome to our school! Let me show you around.

phrases: There is a library in our school.
Where is the classroom? It's next to the office.
There are forty students in my class.

beats.text: Welcome to our school! Is there a library in your old school?
Where is your classroom?
It's next to the office. Are there forty students in your class?

hints: 有什么用 There is / There are
指位置用 next to / behind

title: 聊课程：你最喜欢的科目
goal: 问最喜欢的科目和原因，说出课程安排
place: 午休时，Tom 和你聊今天的课表
brief: Tom 问你今天有什么课、最喜欢哪一科。用 Unit 4 的句型回答，并说清为什么。
opener: What classes do you have today?

cast.name: Tom
cast.stance: 他喜欢体育，会追问你为什么喜欢或不喜欢某一科。
cast.opener: What classes do you have today?

phrases: My favourite subject is English.
Why do you like maths? Because it's fun.
I have PE on Tuesday.

beats.text: What classes do you have today?
What's your favourite subject?
Why do you like it?
I have PE on Tuesday. Do you like PE?

hints: 说科目用 My favourite subject is…
问原因用 Why do you like…

title: 社团招新：你会做什么
goal: 用 can 问能力，报名一个社团
place: 课外活动时间，社团招新摊位
brief: 社团在招新。Mike 问你会什么，你要用 can 说清自己的能力，并决定要不要加入。
opener: Hi! Do you want to join our music club?

cast.name: Mike
cast.stance: 他急着招人，会问 Can you sing / play the guitar，也会介绍社团活动时间。
cast.opener: Hi! Do you want to join our music club?

phrases: Can you play the guitar? Yes, I can.
I can sing, but I can't dance.
Do you want to join the music club?

beats.text: Hi! Do you want to join our music club?
Can you sing or play the guitar?
Great. We meet on Friday afternoon. Can you come?

hints: 回答用 I can / I can't
报名用 I want to join…

title: 一天作息：你几点起床
goal: 用 What time 问作息，说清一天的安排
place: 上学路上，Lucy 和你聊作息
brief: Lucy 问你每天几点起床、几点上学。用 Unit 6 的时间表达和频度副词，把你的作息说清楚。
opener: What time do you get up in the morning?

cast.name: Lucy
cast.stance: 她自己起得很早，会拿你的作息和她比较。
cast.opener: What time do you get up in the morning?

phrases: I get up at six thirty.
What time do you go to bed?
I always do my homework after dinner.

beats.text: What time do you get up in the morning?
What time do you go to school?
I go to bed at ten. What about you?
We always have a busy day!

hints: 问几点用 What time do you…
回答用 I … at + 时间
说自己习惯用 I always…

title: 生日派对：你的生日是什么时候
goal: 问生日日期，用月份和序数词回答
place: 课间，Anna 在写生日派对的邀请卡
brief: Anna 在准备生日派对，问你生日是什么时候。用 Unit 7 的月份和序数词说清日期，并回应邀请。
opener: When is your birthday?

cast.name: Anna
cast.stance: 她热情，会邀请你参加她的生日派对，也会问你几岁。
cast.opener: When is your birthday?

phrases: My birthday is on May 1st.
When is your birthday? It's in June.
Happy birthday! Thank you.

beats.text: When is your birthday?
My birthday is on June 2nd. Come to my party, please!
How old are you?
Great! See you at the party.

hints: 问生日用 When is your birthday
回答用 It's on + 月 + 日
问年龄用 How old are you
